If players do not have enough vis wax in the backpack for a particular action, the remaining balance needed will be used from the bank. This means a player only needs to carry it if they wish to trade it with another player directly or through the Grand Exchange.
▸ Divine locations
Players may extend the daily gathering limit of their divine locations once per day, by either 50% or 100%. The limit may only be increased by one choice of either of the aforementioned amounts (e.g. one cannot extend it by 50% twice, or 50% and 100% for 150%).
▸ Quick-teleport charges
Use of the Lodestone Network includes a quick-teleport option, allowing home teleportation at a faster rate. For every vis wax converted, players may charge 10 quick-teleports. The number of stored charges has a hard cap of 4,000 (this cannot be exceeded by using vis wax with 3,991 or more charges). Please note that the Charge 'All' option will recharge to the hard cap with all available vis wax owned by the player (including wax stored in the player's bank). This can be compared to a cost of if charged with law runes.
▸ Harmony pillars
Players with an already-planted harmony pillar may reset it to change the target skill. Doing so is limited to once per day, resets the gained XP to 0 and requires a new seed to be planted to attune a different skill.
